text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, looks like everyone's on board!
Nobody forgot anything, right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, cheerful as always.
Mr. Driver, take it away please!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, completely different from when we first arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Everyone seemed to be having fun, but it looks like fatigue was catching up with them after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, are you alright?
If you're sleepy, don't hesitate to take a nap.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: See, my shoulder is totally free right now. Right?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, there's no need to be shy.

All in all...
And so, the intense summer training camp came to an end.
